يستحثون (form X)
# يَسْتَحِثُّونَ (yastaḥiṯṯūna) /jas.ta.ħiθ.θuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# يُسْتَحَثُّونَ (yustaḥaṯṯūna) /jus.ta.ħaθ.θuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
